affected_party: QIF maintainers, AI implementation agents, and standalone QIF adopters
actual_problem: The accepted v0.3 Discovery Layer design is committed but not yet published as an immutable release/tag.
why_it_matters: Without a versioned release, downstream work cannot cite a stable Discovery Layer design baseline and may confuse unreleased planning state with accepted scope.
why_now: The v0.3 design slice has been reviewed, verified, committed, and pushed after the v0.2.1 public release.
